Game Overview

Escape Story puts players into a escape experience centered on navigate a haunting city as a brave young boy, pursued by eerie creatures and relentless zombies. Solve perplexing puzzles and unravel the mystery surrounding your perilous predicament. Dive into a thrilling survival quest where quick wits and courage are your only allies against the creepy atmosphere and endless dread.

Each session of Escape Story follows a consistent rhythm. Navigate a haunting city as a brave young boy, pursued by eerie creatures and relentless zombies.
